subject.title: fix(gateway): actively schedule launchd relaunch on supervisor restart

question: Does the launchd lifecycle owner accept the PR's replacement-detection, three-second polling window, and in-process spawn-failure fallback as the intended full-process restart contract?
rationale: Tests and real macOS proof support the implementation, but green CI cannot fully settle launchctl lifecycle and process-ordering semantics in an availability-critical exit path.

options.title: Approve the current lifecycle
